scientific_integrity: All probability statements derive from the projective-line and character proof; exhaustive small finite cases and exact total-variation tests are independently reproducible. No external verification or authorship certification is implied.
scientific_limitations: Only products of uniformly sampled rank-one idempotents over finite fields, with n>=2; no assertion for higher-rank idempotents or arbitrary finite rings. Finite checks corroborate but do not prove the infinite formulas. Historical priority beyond inspected sources is not independently certified.
title: Exact product laws for rank-one matrix idempotents over finite fields
